items.title: Booking Holdings CEO: AI Overviews Are Squeezing SEO
items.summary: No travel business has found the silver bullet yet in how to show up prominently on a consistent basis within the major LLMs. As these platforms evolve, such an achievement becomes a moving target.

items.title: One Airline Is Carrying the Lufthansa Group – It Isn’t Lufthansa
items.summary: As the German group prepares to double down in Rome and potentially Lisbon, the challenge isn’t finding new hubs – it's getting them to perform more like Swiss in Zurich.

items.title: Iran War Drags Down Q2 Earnings for Big Hotel Chains
items.summary: Q2 came in better than feared across the board, thanks to resilient domestic demand. But no one’s calling it over — Q4, the Gulf’s peak season, is the real test.

items.title: Hoshino’s Nara Prison Leans Into the Heritage — a Test Case for Japan’s Historic Buildings
items.summary: Japan’s Hoshino Resorts makes a bold move that blends cultural preservation, tourism strategy, and a new “cycle of heritage” model that blends government ownership with private operation. If it works, the rest of Japan will take notice, with its hard-to-maintain civic architectur

items.title: Steve Singh’s Business Travel Startup Spotnana Is Now 30% Consumer
items.summary: Spotnana is Steve Singh's second act after building and flipping Concur. He's expanding the business travel startup to cover leisure travel, too, after having raised additional funding.

items.title: U.S. Clears Smallest Boeing 737 Max to Fly Following Years of Delays
items.summary: The certification is a big win for Southwest, which has been waiting for the aircraft for years as it looks to grow and replace parts of its aging fleet.

items.title: SAP Concur Adds New AI Tools for Approvals, Cards, and Travel Leakage
items.summary: Most of what SAP Concur announced adds AI to existing tools. The leakage-reporting tool built with Amex GBT is the exception — combining data the two platforms couldn't share before.

items.title: MakeMyTrip: Hotel Growth Offsets Decline in Air Travel; New IPO Details
items.summary: MakeMyTrip says the future of Indian travel growth lies beyond aviation, and is reorganizing both its business and capital structure around that.
